cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.15)

# This file exists to produce the board renders the documentation uses.
#
# They are made with kicad-cli, which ships inside KiCad, so producing pictures
# of a board needs nothing installed beyond KiCad. They are written into the
# documentation tree and committed, because the workflow that publishes the
# hardware site installs Python and MkDocs only -- it has no KiCad to render
# with.
#
# Fabrication outputs are no longer driven from here. They were generated by
# KiBot, an external tool, through an add_pcb_outputs() function that every
# board directory called; that path is retired. The .kibot.yaml files remain in
# the tree to run by hand if wanted.

find_program(kicad_cli_EXECUTABLE kicad-cli
             HINTS /Applications/KiCad/KiCad.app/Contents/MacOS/
             NO_CACHE)

# Renders are committed, so they belong in the source tree, not the build tree.
get_filename_component(_hw_root "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/.." ABSOLUTE)
set(BOARD_RENDER_DIR "${_hw_root}/docs/src/images/boards")

# Camera zoom. kicad-cli's default of 1 frames the board tightly enough to clip
# a coin cell that overhangs the edge, so pull back slightly. Exposed as a cache
# variable because the right value is a judgement about how the images look:
#   cmake -S BoardDesigns -B build-boards -DBOARD_RENDER_ZOOM=0.8
# The CLI documentation describes this as an integer factor. If a fractional
# value is rejected, that documentation is literal and the frame has to be
# widened another way.
set(BOARD_RENDER_ZOOM "0.9" CACHE STRING "kicad-cli camera zoom for board renders")

# Aggregate target: "cmake --build . --target board-renders" redraws every
# board whose .kicad_pcb has changed since its images were written. Deliberately
# not part of ALL -- a normal build should not rewrite files under version
# control.
add_custom_target(board-renders
  COMMENT "Board renders for the documentation")

# Renders for one board, regenerated when its layout changes. The sides to draw
# follow the name: tags are documented from both faces because components sit on
# each, while the bases and prototype carriers are single-sided in any way that
# matters and only need a top view.
function(_board_renders name)
  if(NOT kicad_cli_EXECUTABLE)
    return()
  endif()

  set(board "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/${name}.kicad_pcb")
  set(outputs "")

  foreach(side ${ARGN})
    set(out "${BOARD_RENDER_DIR}/${name}-${side}.png")
    add_custom_command(
      OUTPUT "${out}"
      COMMAND ${CMAKE_COMMAND} -E make_directory "${BOARD_RENDER_DIR}"
      # --background transparent so one image reads correctly against both the
      # light and dark documentation themes. Long option names throughout:
      # kicad-cli's short -h means height, not help.
      #
      # The boards are wider than they are tall. Rotating 90 degrees about Z
      # turns each one portrait, so a pair sits side by side in the
      # documentation's two-column grid without being squeezed. The frame is
      # portrait to match -- otherwise the rotation just moves the empty margin
      # from the sides to the top and bottom.
      COMMAND ${kicad_cli_EXECUTABLE} pcb render
              --side ${side}
              --rotate 0,0,90
              --zoom ${BOARD_RENDER_ZOOM}
              --quality high
              --width 1200
              --height 1600
              --background transparent
              --output "${out}"
              "${board}"
      DEPENDS "${board}"
      COMMENT "Rendering ${name} (${side})"
      VERBATIM)
    list(APPEND outputs "${out}")
  endforeach()

  add_custom_target(${name}-renders DEPENDS ${outputs})
  add_dependencies(board-renders ${name}-renders)
endfunction()

# Both faces -- for the tag boards, which carry parts on each side.
function(add_board_renders name)
  _board_renders(${name} top bottom)
endfunction()

# Top only -- for bases and prototype carriers.
function(add_board_renders_top name)
  _board_renders(${name} top)
endfunction()


message("Configure board renders")

# Only the documented boards are listed. With fabrication outputs no longer
# driven from CMake, a board directory without a render rule contributes
# nothing, so adding it would only be noise.

# Tag boards -- rendered from both faces
add_subdirectory(Tags/BitTagv7)
add_subdirectory(Tags/BitTagNG)
add_subdirectory(Tags/PresTag-v6)
add_subdirectory(Tags/CompassTag)
add_subdirectory(Tags/imutag-smps)
add_subdirectory(Tags/BitPresTagBMP585)

# Base boards -- top view only
add_subdirectory(Bases/tagbase-jlcpcb-v3)
add_subdirectory(Bases/tagbase-lipo-v1)
add_subdirectory(Bases/tag-breakout-u375-smps-v1)
add_subdirectory(Bases/tag-breakout-l432v2)

# Prototype boards -- top view only
add_subdirectory(Prototypes/IMUTagNandBMP581-breakout)
add_subdirectory(Prototypes/UIUCBreakout)
add_subdirectory(Prototypes/steval-daughter-v2)


if(NOT kicad_cli_EXECUTABLE)
    message(STATUS "kicad-cli not found -- board renders cannot be regenerated")
endif()
